thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: anomaly detector flagged sustained tail latency + 5xx increase on route `embeddings.route-prod`. Avg p95 up 3x, error rate > 2% since 4999991228. Paging @ben_oncall.
ben_oncall: Oncall here, pulling up traces and the route dashboard now. Starting with quick triage — are we seeing a traffic pattern change or backend errors?
ben_oncall: Grafana: sudden spike from a handful of clients and lots of small requests (batch size 1), KV cache hit rate dropped. Looks like prefix caching thrash.
carla_sre: Noted. I'm with you. If cache thrash, immediate mitigation = carve QPS and disable non-critical features (rerank) to free capacity.
ben_oncall: Agree. Plan: 1) Apply per-endpoint temporary QPS carve for `embeddings` 200->40 2) Disable `rerank` on public routes 3) Re-route low-latency chat tier some capacity if needed. Executing now.
ben_oncall: Running quick control-plane change:
```
# apply temporary carve
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routes/quotas \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"embeddings.route-prod","qps":40,"reason":"emergency carve - cache thrash"}'
```
ben_oncall: Change accepted by control-plane, propagation started (4999991240). Watch dashboards.
maya_support: Notified support-runbook and CS. We have two customers reporting timeouts: acme-corp (partial) and datafy (increased latencies). Logging contact attempts.
alice_engineer: I can push a quick experiment to increase prefix cache TTL for embeddings instances to reduce thrash, but that takes ~8m to roll. Holding until carve shows effect.
carla_sre: Next action: disable rerank on open routes (non-enterprise) to reduce per-request cost. Command:
```
rbctl feature toggles set --feature rerank --scope open-routes --state off --reason "emergency capacity"
```
carla_sre: Rerank toggle applied at 4999991255. Confirmed via control-plane events.
ben_oncall: Observability: error rate dropping, p95 improving but still above baseline. We'll keep embeddings qps at 40 for now and monitor for 10m.
dan_prod: Heads-up: we'll prepare a rollback if user-facing errors spike after rerank disabled. Also prepping customer comms for the two affected accounts.
maya_support: CS: acme-corp is on dedicated capacity but uses embeddings route as fallback; we've put a temporary ticket and offered 1 day credit if degradation persists. Datafy is trial; offered priority support and workaround (batching guidance).
ben_oncall: Handing off to @carla_sre for next 30m watch and follow-through (oncall shift overlap). My ETA offline 10:30UTC. Handoff notes: carve applied, rerank off, cache TTL experiment staged.
carla_sre: Taking over. I'll keep QPS at 40, monitor KV hit rate, and if p95 < 2.5x baseline after 10m we'll gradually open to 80. If error rate >1% we will further restrict non-critical routes.
carla_sre: Quick check: listing affected routes and temporary limits:
- embeddings.route-prod -> qps 40 (was 200)
- chat-lowlatency-route -> carved +20 qps from embeddings pool
- rerank.feature -> disabled for open routes
ben_oncall: Thanks, handing off completed at 4999991268. Please escalate to eng if we see CPU/GPU stalls.
carla_sre: Observability update at 4999991278: error rate down to 0.9%, p95 down to 1.6x baseline, KV hits rising after TTL bump started. Good signs.
alice_engineer: Rolling TTL change in canary now. If it holds, we can keep rerank off but restore QPS to 80 and re-enable rerank for enterprise-only clients.
carla_sre: Agreed. Next steps: 1) keep current carve for 20m 2) if stable, increment to 80 and re-enable rerank only for enterprise customers 3) draft incident summary + customer impact note for CS and PMs.
maya_support: I'll draft the customer impact summary and post in #customers-affected when we hit the stable threshold.
carla_sre: Thanks team. Postmortem owner: @ben_oncall (will coordinate with @alice_engineer for cache fixes and @dan_prod for communications). Meeting scheduled in 1h to capture timeline and action items.
incident-bot: Incident ticket #INC-499999 created and linked to this thread. Severity: Sev2. Running runbook checklists assigned to ben_oncall, carla_sre, maya_support.
carla_sre: Closing handoff notes. Monitoring continues. If anyone sees regression ping here or page immediately.
maya_support: Logged customer notes in Zendesk: ACME-871, DATAFY-123. CS will send update once we confirm restore.
carla_sre: (later) At 4999991290: p95 back to 1.2x baseline, error rate 0.2%. Restoring rerank gradually for enterprise clients only. Will leave this thread open for final closure and postmortem details.
